Markets.title: Yes Bank moves SC seeking review of order on writing off of Rs 8,415 cr AT-1 bonds
Markets.summary: Yes Bank has asked the Supreme Court to review an October 15 order that upheld a ruling against writing off Rs 8,415 crore in AT-1 bonds. The original Bombay High Court ruling stated that the bank's administrator lacked the authority to write off these bonds during its financial crisis.

Markets.title: RHI Magnesita Q2 net profit jumps 62 pc to over Rs 62 cr
Markets.summary: RHI Magnesita reported a 62 percent jump in net profit to Rs 62.09 crore for the September quarter. The company's consolidated revenues reached Rs 1,038.26 crore while overall expenses decreased compared to the previous year.

Markets.title: Mahanadi Coalfields files RHP for proposed IPO worth nearly Rs 9,500 crore
Markets.summary: Coal India subsidiary Mahanadi Coalfields has filed a Red Herring Prospectus for an initial public offering to sell a 10 percent stake. The proposed IPO aims to raise nearly Rs 9,500 crore through an offer for sale of about 66.18 crore equity shares.

Markets.title: Dalal Street Week Ahead: Can Nifty bulls overcome key resistance levels?
Markets.summary: The Nifty's technical setup has improved significantly following a sharp rebound near its 200-week moving average. However, the index is now approaching key overhead resistance levels that the bulls must overcome.

Markets.title: Concurrent Gainers: 8 stocks gain for 5 days in a row
Markets.summary: Eight selected stocks posted consecutive gains over a five-day period. These equities generated cumulative returns ranging from 7% to 11%.

Markets.title: Binance targets full reopening of withdrawals by next week
Markets.summary: Binance plans to fully reopen withdrawals for all networks and assets by the end of next week. The exchange has recovered 95 percent of the 6.3 billion dollars lost in the October hack and pledged to reimburse affected clients.

Geo-Political.title: Copper wire upgrade caused nationwide flight suspension, US transport secretary says
Geo-Political.summary: A nationwide U.S. flight suspension was caused by an issue during a copper wire upgrade. The U.S. government is investigating whether the incident resulted from faulty equipment or incompetence.

Geo-Political.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that US envoys proposed Ukraine ceding the Donbas region to Russia in exchange for NATO membership. This proposal was reportedly floated as a potential solution to end the ongoing war between the two nations.

Geo-Political.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
Geo-Political.summary: Italy has fined Meta 805 million euros for failing to inform 20 million users that the company accessed their photos. The antitrust authority stated that this lack of transparency violated consumer protection regulations.

Geo-Political.title: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
Geo-Political.summary: Carmelle of the Philippines won the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia. She secured the victory with her women's empowerment anthem titled "Sobra-Sobra."

Geo-Political.title: Second catch attempt for SpaceX Starship rocket
Geo-Political.summary: SpaceX is preparing for a second attempt to catch its Starship rocket booster using mechanical arms at the launch tower. The first attempt failed, resulting in the booster landing in the ocean instead.

Geo-Political.title: Sotheby's auction of $180m Van Gogh challenged over claims it was 'sold under duress'
Geo-Political.summary: Heirs of a former owner are challenging the $180 million Sotheby's auction of a Van Gogh painting, claiming it was originally sold under duress. Sotheby's stated it is working with the family to reach a resolution.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A digital creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without using paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.summary: This article lists the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators stay ahead of the curve and simplify their workflow.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI platform that allows users to generate digital content. It also provides creators with tools to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools used across various industries to drive innovation and efficiency. These tools are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity for a wide range of applications.

Data & Insights.title: Why your monthly grocery bill is rising: Onion prices jump 116%, garlic 61% as South India feels inflation heat
Data & Insights.summary: In October, soaring retail inflation pushed onion prices up by 116% and garlic by 61% across South India. Consequently, all five southern states recorded retail inflation rates above the national average of 6.09%, significantly increasing household grocery expenses.

Data & Insights.title: Indian solar manufacturers look to Germany as China proposes curbs on technology exports
Data & Insights.summary: China is proposing curbs on solar technology exports that could negatively impact India's goal of building a domestic solar manufacturing ecosystem. Specifically, these restrictions threaten India's projection to reach 100 gigawatts of capacity for wafers, ingots, and polysilicon by the end of the decade, prompting Indian manufacturers to look to Germany instead.

Data & Insights.title: Trade deficit widens to 1-year high of $39.88 billion in October on record imports
Data & Insights.summary: India's trade deficit widened to a one-year high of $39.88 billion in October due to a record surge in imports. Although both exports and imports experienced strong growth, the absolute increase in imports outpaced exports.

Data & Insights.title: Retail inflation hits 6.09% in October, crosses RBI's upper tolerance limit
Data & Insights.summary: Retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit. This increase surpassed the 6% two-year high estimated by a Mint poll of 15 economists.

Data & Insights.title: 'New state law to shield investors in Andhra Pradesh'
Data & Insights.summary: Andhra Pradesh is planning a new Investment Protection Act and escrow accounts to guarantee policy continuity and incentives for investors. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu is also introducing reforms to accelerate business and economic growth in the state.

Data & Insights.title: Moody’s raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7%
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's has raised India's fiscal year 2027 growth forecast to 7%. The ratings agency expects this strong economic growth to continue through 2028 due to domestic demand and economic resilience.

India.title: AI Helps Reunite Missing Maharashtra Woman With Family After 2.5 Years
India.summary: Artificial intelligence helped reunite a missing Maharashtra woman with her family after she was separated from them for two-and-a-half years. Her husband traveled to Sanvita Ashram on November 9 to bring her back home following a phone conversation.

India.title: 2 Buses Of Punjab Pilgrimage Scheme Collide, 5 Killed In Tarn Taran
India.summary: Five people were killed in Tarn Taran when two buses under the Punjab Pilgrimage Scheme collided. The crash happened after one bus crossed the road divider to avoid a motorcycle and hit the oncoming bus.

India.title: "Where We Offered Namaz For 400 Years": Asaduddin Owaisi On Akhilesh Yadav's Ayodhya Ram Temple Visit
India.summary: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi criticized Akhilesh Yadav's visit to the Ayodhya Ram Temple by highlighting the long history of Muslims offering namaz at the site. During a rally in Meerut, Owaisi also mocked the Samajwadi Party's 'PDA' slogan.

India.title: Man Seen Eating Dead Dog's Entrails On Highway, Locals Seek Aid For Him
India.summary: Locals on an Indian highway discovered a man sitting beside a dog's carcass and consuming its flesh. Residents are now seeking medical and social aid for the individual.

India.title: Influencer Arrested Over 10.5 kg Madurai Gold Heist. She Knew Where Jewels Were
India.summary: An influencer was arrested by Madurai City Police in connection with a 10.5 kg gold heist. Investigators stated that an accomplice named Nishanth planned the robbery after visiting the jewellery showroom multiple times, and the influencer knew the location of the jewels.

India.title: Amit Shah Interacts With IPS Trainees, Interaction Focuses On National Security
India.summary: Home Minister Amit Shah met with Indian Police Service trainees to discuss national security. The discussion emphasized strengthening internal security and building public trust in law enforcement.

General.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that U.S. officials proposed a peace plan where Ukraine would cede the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership. This proposal was reportedly floated by U.S. envoys as part of efforts to end the ongoing war with Russia.

General.title: Young people should have legal guarantee of job or training, Milburn tells BBC
General.summary: Alan Milburn will propose a legal guarantee of a job or training for young people in an upcoming review on youth unemployment. This policy change would mean some young people would lose their welfare benefits.

General.title: Neets review won't be for the faint-hearted - and will test Burnham's appetite for a welfare fight
General.summary: Alan Milburn is launching a new review to address the problem of young people not in education, employment, or training (Neets). The review will test Andy Burnham's willingness to engage in a political battle over welfare reform.

General.title: Noel Fielding 'appalled' by jokes he made with Russell Brand
General.summary: Noel Fielding stated he is appalled by jokes he previously made with Russell Brand. The *Great British Bake Off* presenter also noted that he has not been in contact with the convicted rapist for many years.
